_comment: Source-controlled Lisa routing authority. Native ChatGPT OAuth is primary and OpenRouter preserves the fallback/media routes. Paid Nemotron is sampled-shadow-only and excluded from defaults and fallbacks. MiniMax-M3 PDF remains approved_unverified until its first controlled proof.

rollback._comment: On provider/model validation failure: disable only PDF document routing; preserve text/image/default-fallback; emit non-secret failure event; never substitute another paid document model.

pdfDocumentModelsCutover._comment: Principal-approved MiniMax-M3 PDF/document candidate (approved_unverified). Observed plugin media PDF default remains MiniMax-M2.7. Do not claim proven PDF support or silently route documents to another paid model.
evidence: First live proof deferred to separately controlled production rollout; first-production-proof receipt required before success claim
extensions/minimax/provider-models.ts MiniMax-M3 catalog input: text+image (PDF unproven at freeze)
extensions/minimax/media-understanding-provider.ts documentModels.pdf textExtraction MiniMax-M2.7 image:false (observed plugin default)

imageModel._comment: Image uses imageModel. PDF uses pdfModel as the approved_unverified candidate.

pdfModel._comment: Approved PDF/document candidate only (capabilityStatus=approved_unverified). First-production-proof receipt required before success claim.

image._comment: Explicit media routing is required because native Luna vision would otherwise bypass agents.defaults.imageModel.
